nodes.label: Design tokens (design/tokens.json)
nodes.rationale: Code uses only the design's colors and font as CSS variables with the same names (--bg, --fg, --accent...); the readable copy is re-exported from pen.dev whenever the design changes.

nodes.label: Always listening 'Hey Pip' wake phrase
nodes.rationale: Only phrases starting with 'Hey Pip' reach the brain; an 8-second follow-up window lets the user just say 'yes'.

nodes.label: go_to plan loop (scan, line up, walk, re-plan, verify)
nodes.norm_label: go_to plan loop (scan, line up, walk, re-plan, verify)
nodes.rationale: Rooms are always indoors (no GPS); a named place turns on GPS and maps. Arrival is verified by seeing the target or proof of a room (a toilet means restroom).

nodes.rationale: Google Maps walking directions when GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set, otherwise OpenStreetMap foot routing as a fallback; every plan includes a Google Maps link.

nodes.label: Pip walking guide for blind people
nodes.norm_label: pip walking guide for blind people
nodes.rationale: Stays out of the way: talks only when needed and otherwise guides with soft taps. Prototype, not a mobility aid. Name ycgsf = 'you can go so far'.

nodes.label: Qwen3-14B brain (conversation + planning agent, llama.cpp Q4_K_M)
nodes.norm_label: qwen3-14b brain (conversation + planning agent, llama.cpp q4_k_m)

nodes.label: RTX 4090 model server over Tailscale
nodes.rationale: The browser (GPS, camera, mic, audio) sends work to models on one GPU machine; run with uvicorn server.app:app on port 8100.

nodes.label: Trail memory and go back
nodes.rationale: Records straight segments, turns and landmarks the camera saw. With GPS it routes back to the start or a saved spot; without GPS Python reverses the trail and the planner model only phrases it.

nodes.label: Ultralytics YOLO11n (objects in front of you)
nodes.norm_label: ultralytics yolo11n (objects in front of you)
nodes.rationale: Only model in the stack under AGPL-3.0; the rest are MIT or Apache 2.0.

nodes.label: untitled.pen (pen.dev design file)
nodes.rationale: Encrypted file: read and edit only through the pen.dev MCP tools (mcp__pencil__*), never with Read or Grep.

nodes.label: Motion + Gestures accessibility rules (VoiceOver labels, Magic Tap, Z-scrub, Reduce Motion, Larger Text)
nodes.norm_label: motion + gestures accessibility rules (voiceover labels, magic tap, z-scrub, reduce motion, larger text)
nodes.rationale: Accessibility rules written in the design's Motion + Gestures frame are part of the design contract, not optional extras.

nodes.label: Design-first rule
nodes.rationale: Any change to what Pip's screen shows (label, button, status line, color) is added to the right pen.dev screen before it is built in code.

nodes.label: pen.dev design contract
nodes.rationale: untitled.pen is the single source of truth for how Pip looks; code follows the design so the app screen and the design never drift apart.

nodes.label: Sound and speech rules (web/app.js)
nodes.rationale: Taps, ticks and what Pip says are not in the visual design; they follow research-based rules kept in web/app.js.

nodes.label: Directional tap guidance
nodes.rationale: Taps come from the side to turn toward, slow when the turn is far and faster when close, silent when on course, so speech is saved for when it is needed.

nodes.label: Headphones upside down channel swap
nodes.rationale: Wearing the cups below the ears swaps left and right, so the app swaps the channels back; T plays a left-then-right test.
